rules.title: Import topology drift (committed markdown vs lirix package AST)
symptoms_stderr_substrings: import-topology-check: docs/lirix_import_topology.md is stale or hand-edited
acceptance_criteria: `docs/lirix_import_topology.md` contains only generator output (no manual edge edits)

rules.title: Git index / worktree desync (tracked file deleted on disk, not staged)
symptoms: `git status --short` shows ` D <path>` for a still-tracked module
acceptance_criteria: No porcelain line begins with space + `D` for listed hazard paths when path remains tracked
If deletion is intentional, commit includes the staged deletion so CI checkout is self-consistent

rules.title: Process gap: code changed lirix→lirix imports without regenerating topology doc
remediation_architecture: Treat `docs/lirix_import_topology.md` as a build artifact tied to `lirix/**/*.py` import edges
On any PR touching `lirix/`, run `gen_lirix_import_graph.py` before merge if imports changed
verify_commands: git diff --name-only HEAD~1 -- lirix/ && python tools/gen_lirix_import_graph.py --check

rules.title: Optional redundancy: governance-only harness gates not duplicated on PR Fast Required
rules.note: By design per docs/ci_gate_matrix.md; not a defect unless policy mandates single-lane full duplication.
remediation_architecture: If policy changes: add selected gates to Fast Required or require governance lane as branch protection check

rules.title: Local environment: test-coverage-required without dev extras

harness_backlog_optional.title: Single `harness fast-required-local-chain` mirroring CI Fast Required order
harness_backlog_optional.rationale: Extra redundancy for human operators; implemented as `python tools/harness.py fast-required-local-chain`

harness_backlog_optional.title: Optional `--enforce` parity for doc-preamble on release tags
harness_backlog_optional.rationale: Stricter zero-warning posture when noise is eliminated
